candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Parent train has no verified definition or direct superclasses, so its BFO category is not established by source facts.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a train with a passenger-transport differentia, so subclassing train is internally coherent with that genus. No verified parent definition or superclass axiom is available, and the unapproved train–material-entity proposal is not evidence.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Temporal proper parts are implied by travel rather than explicitly stated; journeys only toward an arrival station remain processes.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Verified parent process is an occurrent, not a role. The child is defined as a train-travel process between stations, matching the process genus and its temporal, material-participant elucidation.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Aboutness for a journey that may not yet occur is not further axiomatized; no source contradiction.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Verified parent is an information content entity and a generically dependent continuant. The child is defined as an ICE specifying an intended rail journey and explicitly not that travel process.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Bearer is restricted to an undefined person class; that differentia is unverified. The other proposed parent is not an approved source fact.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Verified parent is BFO role, a realizable entity. The child is defined as a role inhering in a bearer and realized by rail-passenger participation, and it is explicitly not itself a person.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Parent definition text is missing, so the passenger role differentia cannot be checked against the rail-journey differentia. Do not retype passenger as the person who bears the role.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Source axioms place passenger directly under BFO role, so it is a role type, not a person, bearer, or untyped occupant. A rail-specific passenger role is a plausible specialization, but role ancestry alone does not prove the subclass.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: No parent definition is supplied, so fit to this reservation class’s differentia is unverified. Wording could be misread as a reserving act, though the stated genus is ICE.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Verified parent is an information content entity. The child is defined as an ICE that is reservation information about rail-journey participation, so a narrower subclass is generically compatible.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Physical versus information bearer scope for rail ticket is unresolved. Electronic ticket content would be generically dependent information, not a material information bearer; including it would make this subclass too narrow or incorrect.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Under the stated definition the child is a material information bearer, and verified ticket is a subclass of IAO material information bearer, so that physical reading is compatible. Parent type alone does not prove the subclass.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: A station is often modeled as a BFO site rather than only the material facility aggregate; site versus material-entity scope is not settled by the verified axioms.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Verified parent is BFO material entity, an independent continuant. The child is defined as a material aggregate of physical railway facilities with material parts, fitting that elucidation.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Object versus object-aggregate status of a multi-vehicle train is unspecified; either remains a material entity.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Verified parent is BFO material entity. The child is defined as a material entity composed of one or more rail vehicles, satisfying the matter-as-part elucidation.

method: Separate held-out cosine and source-grounded Grok. No numeric hybrid probability until calibrated with independent positives AND negatives.

score_interpretation.cosine: [-1,1] vector directional similarity only, not entailment or subclass confidence
score_interpretation.cosine_reference_percentile_descriptive: Fraction of held-out source/import subclass pairs with cosine <= rail pair. NOT a validity probability; no negative-label control.
score_interpretation.hybrid_confidence_score: Always null until a proper labeled calibration is created; the v1 weighted number is saved only for audit
score_interpretation.llm_plausibility: Uncalibrated heuristic supplied by Grok; must be checked against verified source facts

unresolved_design_decisions: rail ticket physical bearer vs electronic information
